verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a public REST API (contacts, custom objects, webhooks) and an official CLI (npm install -g @hubspot/cli) for building integrations, plus MCP servers for agentic tools, but the evidence pack never names or links official language SDKs (e.g., Node/Python/PHP client libraries) and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt/docs.md machine-readable interface (404s), suggesting a thinner 'SDK-native' developer experience than the API/CLI surface implies. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK documentation/links, working OpenAPI spec discovery, independent confirmation of SDK quality/maintenance.
